# CNN Academy

> > Global journalism training and education platform offering courses, workshops, and degree programs in multimedia storytelling, AI journalism, and digital media production.

CNN Academy operates internationally with programs in Abu Dhabi, Dublin, Atlanta, Hong Kong, and other major cities, providing professional development for journalists through hands-on newsroom simulations and partnerships with institutions like University College Dublin. The Academy emphasizes modern journalism skills including mobile journalism, AI integration, and multimedia storytelling techniques.

## Key Topics

- journalism training
- multimedia storytelling
- AI journalism
- mobile journalism
- newsroom simulation
- international affairs reporting
- digital journalism
- masters degree programs
- summer institutes
- global journalism education
- LumaFusion mobile editing
- journalism workshops
- media production
- CNN training programs
- international media education

- [Courses - CNN Academy](https://academy.cnn.com/courses/): Main course directory for CNN Academy journalism training programs
